description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API implementation for a chatbot application that uses Google Gemini as the language model. It includes endpoints for health check, answering questions, chat interface, listing answers from a text file, and providing Gemini configuration info. The code manages environment variables, constructs prompts with context from 'answers.txt', and handles API responses with robust error handling and logging.

classes.name: ChatQuery
classes.description: Model for a user query to the chat/answer endpoint.

classes.name: ChatAnswer
classes.description: Model for answer response from Gemini.

classes.name: FastAPIHTTP400
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling 400 errors in FastAPI.

methods.description: Handles FastAPIHTTP400 exceptions and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: get_answers_txt_context

methods.name: query_gemini_live
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the Gemini API and extracts the answer from the response.

methods.name: chat_interface
